Pakistan mediating; Pakistan interior minister flew to Tehran. US and Iranian envoys/trump envoy headed to Switzerland. Talks ongoing but opaque.
  • Logistics & finance: Reports of arrangements to unfreeze Iranian funds for humanitarian goods (US/Qatar). Potential first-time economic relief to ease civilian shortages if implemented.
  • International moves: No large troop deployments reported. Flight tracking shows increased military air traffic (multiple C-130/RCH flights).
  • 🟢 Good News: Temporary pause on energy strikes announced; Pakistan-mediated contacts and planned Swiss talks create a diplomatic channel.
  • Bottom line: Threat assessment: Escalating.
